title: Git history record schemas
responsibility: Defines the refs and validated note, evidence and legacy record formats used by Git-backed history.

outputs.name: sourceArchivePrefix
outputs.description: Prefix refs/harness/source/ for per-commit source archive refs.

outputs.name: remoteTrackingPrefix
outputs.description: Prefix refs/harness/remotes/ for fetched history refs awaiting merge.

outputs.name: evidencePointerSchema
outputs.description: Strict pointer schema containing an evidence commit, nonempty path and SHA-256 manifest digest.

outputs.name: historyNoteSchema
outputs.description: Discriminated strict version 1 note schemas for verification, change reason and legacy report, each bound to its source commit.

outputs.name: evidenceFileSchema
outputs.description: Strict file schema with nonempty path, lowercase SHA-256, nonnegative integer byte size, git/lfs storage and optional media type.

outputs.name: evidenceManifestSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 manifest schema naming record, source commit/tree, pass/fail status and evidence files.

outputs.name: legacyRecordSchema
outputs.description: Strict version 1 legacy-report schema preserving report facts, checks and media provenance, with nullable media hash/size and revision.
